name: Versily

sources.title: Start/product route — redirects toward login (SPA, no content to fetcher)
Versily llms.txt — platform structure: products, ideation, stories, workspaces
About — 'social network for digital product creators'
Submitmap profile — account options and publish-to-community flow

requirements: Account required: Google, X, GitHub, LinkedIn, or email+password
Versily is a project workspace first (projects, docs, tasks) — a listing is a one-click 'publish to community' on a project you create inside the platform, not a standalone form
Product needs a name, live URL, one-line description, and up to three categories; logo optional
preparation: Product name, live URL, one-line description, ≤3 category choices, optional logo
Expect to set up a lightweight project/workspace rather than a single form
workflow: Sign in via Google, X, GitHub, LinkedIn, or email
Create the project in the workspace
Publish it to the community ('launch to our community with one click')
Product lands in the /products feed and the 'Just Released' section (filterable All Products / AI Products), with a score and up to 3 category tags
watchFor: Not a pure directory: the value comes from using the build-in-public workspace — a bare link-drop listing is possible but the platform is structured around projects
SPA — no usable HTML without JavaScript
No paid submission tier was found on public pages, but visibility mechanics (score, feed position) are not documented
countsAsLive: A public product page exists under versily.com/products/<slug> and the product appears in the Just Released feed
unknowns: Whether any review/moderation step exists before publishing
